blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Two to four tropical cyclones are expected to develop in or enter the Philippine area of responsibility (PAR) from November 2026 to April 2027 amid the presence of El Niño, the state weather bureau said Wednesday. During a climate forum organized by the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa), Assistant Weather Services Chief Ana Liza Solis said one to two tropical cyclones are expected in November and December 2026.
